title: Awak in Nigeria people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Awak are a small tribe, speaking Awak, an Adamawa language. They use Hausa as a secondary or trade language. The Awak are closely related to the Tangale people who live west of them and with whom they share similarities in marriage customs, religious practices, music and dances.
